# Contributing

感谢您对本项目的关注！| Thanks for your interest!

---

## 🐛 报告问题 | Report Bugs

发现问题？请通过 [Issues](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/TJU-RL-template/issues) 告诉我们：
- 描述问题
- 提供编译环境（TeX Live 版本、操作系统）
- 附上错误日志或截图

Found a bug? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/TJU-RL-template/issues) with:
- Description of the problem
- Your environment (TeX Live version, OS)
- Error logs or screenshots

---

## 💡 提交改进 | Submit Changes

1. **Fork** 本仓库 | Fork this repository
2. **创建分支** | Create a branch
   ```bash
   git checkout -b fix/your-fix
   ```
3. **提交更改** | Make your changes
4. **测试** | Test
   ```bash
   xelatex main.tex
   ```
5. **提交 PR** | Submit a Pull Request

---

## ✅ 简单规则 | Simple Rules

- ✅ 保持单页布局 | Keep single-page layout
- ✅ 测试编译无误 | Test compilation works
- ✅ 不要破坏现有功能 | Don't break existing features
- ✅ 友好交流 | Be respectful

**没有复杂要求，保持简单！| No complex requirements, keep it simple!**

---
